title: LAX–HKG–NRT: Rohan Iyer
notice: Source-reviewed on 2026-11-03. Air Beluga, passengers, documents and operational checks are fictional. Real airline networks inspire the routes; no affiliation or independent human review is claimed.

review.notes: Reviewed the finite route, passport conditions, entry/transit exceptions and available evidence against the cited official sources. See docs/content-review-networks-2026-11-03.md. This is an agent source review, not independent human or immigration-authority approval.

assumptions: All passengers and documents are synthetic. Travel begins on 2026-11-03; connections arrive at the hub on 2026-11-04. Flight clocks are invented for this puzzle, not a live timetable. All unmentioned identity, security, funds, return/onward bookings, health and departure checks are stipulated satisfied. SG Arrival Card submission is complete where needed; it is never a visa substitute.

Only the documents and facts shown or obtainable through the offered checks are available. Unless expressly identified, the traveller has an ordinary passport, no additional citizenship, no destination residence, special passport, crew, e-Channel or other exemption. Short tourism only; no work. Routine entry permissions for an untested leg are not silently assumed when that leg is part of the puzzle.

Air Beluga training procedure (fictional carrier policy): complete the offered checks. Escalate a material eligibility, identity or transfer conflict that remains unresolved after those checks; deny a confirmed requirement failure once relevant obtainable alternatives are excluded. Unfamiliarity alone is insufficient. No live airline or government systems are called.
clues: Two booking references, one bag. The check-in agent and transfer note disagree about where I collect it.

questions.label: Verify Hong Kong baggage and boarding-pass handling
questions.response: The origin record promises through baggage and an airside boarding pass; the connecting booking says landside bag collection and check-in. The handling desk cannot confirm which applies.

questions.label: Ask for Hong Kong permission or exemption
questions.response: No Hong Kong visa, successful registration, residence permission, e-Channel enrolment, diplomatic/official passport, crew or other exemption is available.

rationale: Separate tickets alone do not determine immigration clearance. The actual handling remains in conflict, and the traveller has no Hong Kong entry permission if landside processing is necessary. Japanese permission is complete; escalate the unresolved HK transfer.
